top_signals.title: Asia Is Building 73% of the World's New Nuclear Capacity
top_signals.summary: The Middle East crisis and the spiking oil and gas prices have shifted the Asian nations’ priorities to energy security and generating electricity with homegrown resources. Renewable energy capacity is soaring, not only in the top emerging markets China and India, but also across Southeast Asia, as the Strait of Hormuz crisis hiked LNG prices and dented gas demand. Another clean energy source, nuclear capacity, is also gaining momentum globally. Countries worldwide started thinking about adding or building nuclear reactors for the first time…

top_signals.title: How Brazil Plans to Accelerate the Global Shift Away From Fossil Fuels
top_signals.summary: Brazil has launched two roadmaps to encourage other countries around the globe to accelerate the phasing out of fossil fuels and plan for a green transition. The roadmaps offer broad frameworks to encourage countries to develop their own, more specific, national climate and energy plans. Brazil, the host of last year’s UN COP30 climate summit, announced the launch of its roadmaps in early November, ahead of COP31, which is being held in Turkey from 9th to 20th November.
